45/G.goal: Plan an empirical usability evaluation for an implemented XR system by outlining its stages and designing a testable experiment with measurable research questions and variables.
45/G.achieves: It supports the course aim of implementing XR systems with confidence by showing how to move from code testing to an objective, structured usability evaluation for an XR system.

45/O1.goal: Describe the role of empirical usability evaluation in system implementation and the requirements and stages of a full usability study.
45/O1.achieves: It lets the learner recognize when empirical evaluation is needed after code testing and understand the structure of a full usability study before designing its experiments.

45/O2.goal: Design an empirical usability experiment by turning broad usability concerns into testable, measurable research questions and identifying the relevant variables and levels.
45/O2.achieves: It enables the learner to specify what will be measured in an XR usability evaluation and how the test conditions support objective conclusions.
